name: jevhunt
description: The directory for software built on Jev — Cloudflare Pages + D1 + Google OAuth

scripts.build: node tools/check-project-content.mjs --ledger-only && node tools/build-project-content.mjs && node tools/build-browser-catalog.mjs && node tools/prerender-catalog.mjs && node tools/localize.mjs && node tools/build-directory.mjs && node tools/build-editorial.mjs && node tools/stamp.mjs && node tools/build-manifest.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run content:check && npm run build && npm test && npm run db:migrate:remote && npm run catalog:seed:remote && npm run deploy:worker && npm run content:publish:remote && wrangler pages deploy public --project-name jevhunt --branch main --commit-dirty=true && npm run verify:production && npm run content:verify:production
scripts.db:studio: wrangler d1 execute jevhunt-db --remote --command "SELECT id, email, name, created_at FROM users ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20;"
